deviceFingerprint.description: ADR-017 阶段 3（protocol v6）：发起回调的执行器的稳定安装标识——sha256(deviceId + ':' + installSalt)，64 位小写十六进制字符，与 register/heartbeat 同值。它是本次回调的**行身份**：共享/旧版 token 不绑定任何行，且当 pull 模式的执行器共用同一地址后，`executorAddress` 已无法唯一标识一行（ADR-017 §5）。admin 用它把回调归属到该执行实际派发到的那一行。可选——旧版执行器、采集失败以及 SDK 调用方会省略；此时 admin 依次回落到凭据持有行、再回落到地址相等（绝不因缺失而拒绝）。
deviceFingerprint.x-i18n-en: ADR-017 phase 3 (protocol v6): stable install identifier of the executor that issued the callback -- sha256(deviceId + ':' + installSalt), 64 lowercase hex chars, same value as register/heartbeat. It is the row identity of this callback: shared/legacy tokens are bound to no row, and once pull-mode executors share an address, `executorAddress` can no longer uniquely identify a row (ADR-017 §5). admin uses it to attribute the callback to the exact row this execution was dispatched to. Optional -- legacy executors, collection failures and SDK callers omit it; admin then falls back to the credential-owning row, then to address equality (never rejecting for its absence).

durationMinutes.x-i18n-en: Silence duration (minutes, 1..5256000 = 10 years); defaults to the system TTL (P3-1 upper bound)

level.x-i18n-en: Silence exactly this level (exact match, not "and below"); empty = all levels

scope.x-i18n-en: Silence scope: global=all channels; task=single task; application=single application

codeSource.description: 代码来源渠道。gitRepo / glueSource / codeSource=application_zip（需配 applicationId）三者中只能设置一个。PATCH 时缺省 = 保留当前值；显式 null = 清除声明。requirements/PyPI 属于依赖型渠道，可与任一代码来源并存。
codeSource.x-i18n-en: Code source channel. Only one of gitRepo / glueSource / codeSource=application_zip (requires applicationId) may be set. On PATCH, omitting it = keep the current value; an explicit null = clear the declaration. requirements/PyPI is a dependency-type channel and may coexist with any code source.

dependencies.description: 上游任务依赖映射：{ 显示名: 上游任务id }——**value 才是依赖任务 id**（环检测、依赖满足、扇出匹配等所有消费方都读 value）。每个 value 必须是已存在的任务 id；自依赖与循环在写面即被拒绝。
dependencies.x-i18n-en: Upstream task dependency map: { display name: upstream task id } - **the value is the dependency task id** (all consumers, including cycle detection, dependency satisfaction, and fan-out matching, read the value). Every value must be an existing task id; self-dependencies and cycles are rejected on the write path.

deploymentPolicy.description: FEAT-22：任务级部署派发策略覆盖。'strict' 把候选收窄为显式部署了绑定应用的设备集合（running/stopped/upgrading）；当其中没有任何设备可承接该执行时，执行会以 WAITING 排队，而不是静默派发到别处。'prefer' 保留 ARCH-35 的软偏好（优先尝试已部署且运行中的设备，否则回落到全集群）。缺省/null = 跟随全局 executor.deploymentPolicy（EXECUTOR_DEPLOYMENT_POLICY）。优先级：executorId 钉定 > executorAppName > 部署约束 > 全集群；总开关 executor.preferDeployedExecutor=false 会彻底关闭部署感知。PATCH：缺省 = 保留；显式 null = 跟随全局。
deploymentPolicy.x-i18n-en: FEAT-22: task-level deployment dispatch policy override. 'strict' narrows the candidates to the set of devices that explicitly deployed the bound application (running/stopped/upgrading); when none of them can take the execution, it queues as WAITING instead of being silently dispatched elsewhere. 'prefer' keeps the ARCH-35 soft preference (try deployed and running devices first, otherwise falls back to the whole cluster). Default/null = follow the global executor.deploymentPolicy (EXECUTOR_DEPLOYMENT_POLICY). Precedence: executorId pinning > executorAppName > deployment constraint > whole cluster; the master switch executor.preferDeployedExecutor=false turns deployment awareness off entirely. PATCH: omitted = keep; explicit null = follow the global setting.

estimatedDurationSec.description: CORE-05：预估执行时长（秒；0 或缺省 = 未知）。仅用于调度侧的 executor 负载评分（预估越长，对繁忙执行器的惩罚越大）；执行链路（心跳/超时/统计）从不消费该字段。PATCH 时显式 null = 重置为未知。
estimatedDurationSec.x-i18n-en: CORE-05: estimated execution duration (seconds; 0 or default = unknown). Used only by the scheduling side for executor load scoring (a longer estimate penalizes busy executors more); the execution path (heartbeat/timeout/statistics) never consumes this field. On PATCH, an explicit null = reset to unknown.

executeMode.description: 派发模式：single（在符合条件的执行器中选择负载最低的一台，缺省）或 broadcast（扇出到所有符合条件的在线执行器）。与 executorId 钉定互斥；当绑定应用带有互斥组时以 400 拒绝（broadcast 无法遵守组内并发上限）。
executeMode.x-i18n-en: Dispatch mode: single (pick the least loaded of the eligible executors; default) or broadcast (fan out to all eligible online executors). Mutually exclusive with pinning via executorId; rejected with 400 when the bound application has a mutex group (broadcast cannot honor the in-group concurrency cap).

executorAffinityTags.description: NF-04：执行器标签亲和（OR 语义——持有其中**任一**标签的执行器即为候选；随后在命中集合内按 loadScore 择优）。broadcast 模式下扇出收窄为命中亲和标签的执行器子集。与 executorTags（硬性 AND 子集能力要求）正交。PATCH：缺省 = 保留；显式 null/[] = 清除。
executorAffinityTags.x-i18n-en: NF-04: executor tag affinity (OR semantics - an executor holding **any** of these tags is a candidate; the best is then chosen within the matching set by loadScore). In broadcast mode the fan-out narrows to the subset of executors matching the affinity tags. Orthogonal to executorTags (a hard AND subset capability requirement). PATCH: default = keep; explicit null/[] = clear.

executorAntiAffinityTags.description: NF-04：执行器标签反亲和（排除语义——持有其中**任一**标签的执行器即被排除）。单发与 broadcast 均生效；与亲和标签组合时，先取亲和命中集再在其上剔除。PATCH：缺省 = 保留；显式 null/[] = 清除。
executorAntiAffinityTags.x-i18n-en: NF-04: executor label anti-affinity (exclusion semantics - an executor holding **any** of these labels is excluded). Applies to both single dispatch and broadcast; when combined with affinity labels, the affinity hit set is taken first and then filtered. PATCH: default = keep; explicit null/[] = clear.

executorId.description: 把任务钉定到指定执行器：派发**只**发往该执行器（绕过分组/标签过滤）；它离线时快速失败。与 executeMode=broadcast 互斥。
executorId.x-i18n-en: Pin the task to a specific executor: dispatch goes **only** to that executor (bypassing group/label filtering); it fails fast when that executor is offline. Mutually exclusive with executeMode=broadcast.

maintenanceWindows.description: 任务级维护窗口：落在窗口内的定时触发会被跳过（手动/API 触发不受影响）。每项为 {start, end, description?}，start/end 均为 5 字段 cron；窗口在最近一次 start-cron 触达时开启、在最近一次 end-cron 触达时关闭。最多 10 条。
maintenanceWindows.x-i18n-en: Task-level maintenance windows: scheduled triggers falling inside a window are skipped (manual/API triggers are unaffected). Each entry is {start, end, description?}, where start/end are both 5-field cron; a window opens at the most recent start-cron hit and closes at the most recent end-cron hit. At most 10 entries.

name.description: 任务名称——允许任意语言（含中文/日文/emoji）。拒绝控制字符与首尾空白；长度上限 255 字符。全部任务（含软删除行）内全局唯一。
name.x-i18n-en: Task name - any language allowed (including Chinese/Japanese/emoji). Control characters and leading/trailing whitespace are rejected; maximum length 255 characters. Globally unique across all tasks (including soft-deleted rows).

params.description: 任务默认参数；序列化后体积不得超过 65536 字节（与 trigger/webhook 面同一上限）。
params.x-i18n-en: Default task parameters; the serialized size must not exceed 65536 bytes (the same limit as the trigger/webhook surface).

projectId.description: 所属项目。缺省/null = 未分配（计入默认项目视图；与既有行为一致）。设置它需要 ADMIN 或该项目的 editor/admin。
projectId.x-i18n-en: Owning project. Default/null = unassigned (counted in the default project view; consistent with existing behavior). Setting it requires ADMIN or editor/admin on that project.

requirements.description: 任务运行前由执行器安装的依赖声明——pip 依赖（python runtime，每任务独立 uv venv）或 npm 包（node runtime）。GLUE 脚本任务忽略该字段。示例：[\"requests>=2.31\", \"rich==13.7.1\"]
requirements.x-i18n-en: Dependency declaration installed by the executor before the task runs - pip dependencies (python runtime, a separate uv venv per task) or npm packages (node runtime). GLUE script tasks ignore this field. Example: [\"requests>=2.31\", \"rich==13.7.1\"]

runOnUpstreamFailure.description: 失败边：上游依赖进入失败终态（FAILED/TIMEOUT/KILLED/CANCELLED）时也触发本任务（默认 false）
runOnUpstreamFailure.x-i18n-en: Failure edge: also trigger this task when an upstream dependency reaches a failed terminal state (FAILED/TIMEOUT/KILLED/CANCELLED) (default false)

runbook.description: FEAT-11：markdown 运维手册——展示在任务详情页，并随失败通知/告警一并附上。
runbook.x-i18n-en: FEAT-11: markdown runbook - shown on the task detail page and attached to failure notifications/alerts.

runtimeVersion.description: 任务所需的 Python 解释器版本，格式为 \"major.minor\"（例如 \"3.7\"、\"3.12\"）。支持区间默认 3.7–3.14；3.7 仅支持离线预置（uv 无法在线下载）。仅在 runtime=python 时有意义。
runtimeVersion.x-i18n-en: Python interpreter version required by the task, in \"major.minor\" format (for example \"3.7\", \"3.12\"). The supported range defaults to 3.7-3.14; 3.7 is available only as an offline preset (uv cannot download it online). Only meaningful when runtime=python.

secrets.description: 任务级 secrets（凭据键值对，独立于 params 的普通运行参数；配置了 SEC_SECRETS_KEY 时以 AES-256-GCM 加密落库，未配置则降级明文并告警）。读路径一律以字面量 ****** 掩码。派发时走两条通道：合并进 params（AUTOFLOW_<KEY>，旧执行器通道）并作为独立载荷字段下发，使执行器按**原名**注入（第三方 SDK 要求规范名）。PATCH 时按**逐键合并**：键缺省或叶子值为 ****** 时保留已存值，叶子值为 null 时删除该键，其它值覆盖；整个字段显式 null 时清空全部 secret。
secrets.x-i18n-en: Task-level secrets (credential key-value pairs, independent of the ordinary run parameters in params; persisted encrypted with AES-256-GCM when SEC_SECRETS_KEY is configured, otherwise degraded to plaintext with a warning). Read paths always mask them with the literal ******. Dispatch uses two channels: merged into params (AUTOFLOW_<KEY>, the legacy executor channel) and sent as a separate payload field so the executor injects them under their **original names** (third-party SDKs require canonical names). On PATCH they are merged **key by key**: a missing key or a leaf value of ****** keeps the stored value, a leaf value of null deletes that key, any other value overwrites; an explicit null for the whole field clears all secrets.

timeout.description: 任务执行超时秒数（遗留字段；建议使用 timeoutSeconds）。0 = 不限制；上限为执行器的 1..86400 窗口（executor-node 每次尝试都会以 400 拒绝更大的值）。
timeout.x-i18n-en: Task execution timeout in seconds (legacy field; prefer timeoutSeconds). 0 = unlimited; capped by the executor's 1..86400 window (executor-node rejects larger values with 400 on every attempt).

timeoutAction.description: CORE-04：任务超时后的动作。kill（缺省）= 执行器按既有语义树杀进程；kill_retry = 同样树杀，但 admin 按任务的重试预算重新入队一次执行；notify_only = admin 只下发超时告警、不额外下发终止指令（执行器自身的硬超时仍然生效）。PATCH 时缺省 = 保留当前值；显式 null = 重置回 kill。
timeoutAction.x-i18n-en: CORE-04: action after a task times out. kill (default) = the executor kills the process tree using the existing semantics; kill_retry = the same tree kill, but admin re-enqueues one execution according to the task's retry budget; notify_only = admin only raises a timeout alert and sends no extra termination instruction (the executor's own hard timeout still applies). On PATCH, absent = keep the current value; explicit null = reset back to kill.

timeoutSeconds.description: 任务执行超时秒数。0 = 不限制；上限为执行器的 1..86400 窗口（会归一化到 `timeout`，executor-node 对超过 86400 的值以 400 拒绝）。
timeoutSeconds.x-i18n-en: Task execution timeout in seconds. 0 = no limit; capped at the executor's 1..86400 window (normalized to `timeout`; executor-node rejects values above 86400 with 400).

timeoutWarnRatio.description: CORE-04：超时预警阈值，取 timeout 的百分数（整数 0-90）。运行时长达到 timeout × ratio/100 时发送一次 WARNING 预警通知（每个执行至多一次）。缺省/null = 未启用。
timeoutWarnRatio.x-i18n-en: CORE-04: timeout warning threshold, a percentage of timeout (integer 0-90). When the run duration reaches timeout x ratio/100, one WARNING notice is sent (at most once per execution). Default/null = disabled.

timezone.description: cron 调度使用的 IANA 时区，例如 Asia/Shanghai
timezone.x-i18n-en: IANA time zone used for cron scheduling, e.g. Asia/Shanghai

category.description: 粗分类标签（备份/巡检/同步/清理/通知…），前端渲染为 Tag
category.x-i18n-en: Coarse category label (backup/inspection/sync/cleanup/notification...), rendered as a Tag by the frontend

config.description: 合法 CreateTaskDto 子集（省略 name）；作为实例化任务的默认值
config.x-i18n-en: Valid subset of CreateTaskDto (omitting name); used as defaults for the instantiated task

key.description: 稳定标识；缺省由 name 规整生成。官方模板保留 [a-z][a-z0-9_-]* 命名风格。
key.x-i18n-en: Stable identifier; generated by default from a normalized name. Official templates keep the [a-z][a-z0-9_-]* naming style.

password.description: 至少 8 个字符，且必须包含大写字母、小写字母、数字和特殊字符
password.x-i18n-en: At least 8 characters, and must contain uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters

executorIds.description: 仅对这些执行器对应的 RUNNING 部署行下发（重复 id 幂等去重）。缺省 = 该应用全部 RUNNING 部署行（与旧 rollback 一致）。执行器无部署行/行状态不可下发的进响应 skipped 明细，不报错
executorIds.x-i18n-en: Dispatch only to the RUNNING deployment rows of these executors (duplicate ids are deduped idempotently). Default = all RUNNING deployment rows of the application (same as the legacy rollback). Executors without a deployment row, or whose row is not dispatchable, are reported in the response skipped list instead of raising an error

versionId.description: application_versions.id（版本快照主键，非 version 号字符串）——status 必须为 released；下发前先按该快照恢复应用当前字段
versionId.x-i18n-en: application_versions.id (the version snapshot primary key, not the version number string) — status must be released; the application's current fields are restored from this snapshot before dispatching

dispatched.description: 恒 true——本端点就是下发动作（恢复+下发）
dispatched.x-i18n-en: Always true — this endpoint is the dispatch action itself (restore + dispatch)

updatedApp.description: 恢复后的应用行（已掩码）

version.description: 本次下发的目标版本（= 快照 version）
version.x-i18n-en: The version dispatched this time (= the snapshot version)

detail.description: 跳过原因的机器可读补充（状态值 / 原始错误消息）
detail.x-i18n-en: Machine-readable supplement for the skip reason (status value / raw error message)

executorId.description: 显式点名路径下恒有值；缺省（全 RUNNING）路径下取部署行值
executorId.x-i18n-en: Always present on the explicit-targeting path; on the default (all RUNNING) path it takes the deployment row's value

reason.description: no_deployment=该执行器在本应用下没有部署行；not_running=最新部署行状态非 running（detail 带实际 status）；upgrade_rejected=upgrade 链拒绝（detail 带原因）
reason.x-i18n-en: no_deployment = the executor has no deployment row under this application; not_running = the latest deployment row is not running (detail carries the actual status); upgrade_rejected = the upgrade chain rejected it (detail carries the reason)

executorId.description: 部署行所在执行器（行无执行器时 null）
executorId.x-i18n-en: The executor of the deployment row (null when the row has no executor)

currentReleaseKey.description: current 软链指向的 release 目录名
currentReleaseKey.x-i18n-en: release directory name the current symlink points to

currentVersion.description: 设备 current 软链指向的版本；无 current（未部署成功）为 null
currentVersion.x-i18n-en: version the device's current symlink points to; null when there is no current (never deployed successfully)

lastDeployedAt.description: 最近一次部署完成时刻（ISO 8601）；无记录为 null
lastDeployedAt.x-i18n-en: last deployment completion time (ISO 8601); null when there is no record

retainedVersions.description: 设备 releases/ 下仍保留的版本集合（prune 后快照）
retainedVersions.x-i18n-en: versions still kept under the device's releases/ (post-prune snapshot)

runMode.description: 部署/升级时选择的运行模式；设备侧无记录为 null
runMode.x-i18n-en: run mode chosen at deploy/upgrade time; null when the device has no record

message.description: 自由格式的进度信息（最长 2000 字符；写入 statusMessage 文本列并进入列表读面）

deployedApps.description: R3-A（§4.3）：设备级应用版本事实（apps/ 目录扫描）。缺省 → 中台完全不动既有事实行（旧执行器）；[] → 设备上没有任何已部署应用（整替 = 全部既有行删除）；结构非法/超 50 项/同一 appId 重复 → 整字段拒绝采纳。落库语义：整替该执行器全部 executor_app_versions 行（数组外的应用 = 设备已卸载）。
deployedApps.x-i18n-en: R3-A (§4.3): device-level application version facts (scan of the apps/ directory). Omitted -> the platform leaves existing fact rows completely untouched (legacy executors); [] -> the device has no deployed applications (full replacement = all existing rows deleted); structurally invalid, more than 50 items, or a duplicate appId -> the whole field is rejected. Persistence semantics: full replacement of all executor_app_versions rows for this executor (applications absent from the array = uninstalled on the device).

deviceFingerprint.description: ARCH-36（ADR-017 第二/三阶段）：稳定的安装身份 —— sha256(deviceId + ':' + installSalt)，64 位小写十六进制字符。ADR-017 第三阶段把它定为行查找键：register/heartbeat 先按指纹解析行，因此换了 IP 的机器会复用既有行，而不是新建幽灵行。缺省/非法 → 保留已存值（legacy 或采集失败的执行器绝不能把已存指纹清空），并回退到按地址查找。
deviceFingerprint.x-i18n-en: ARCH-36 (ADR-017 phase 2/3): stable installation identity - sha256(deviceId + ':' + installSalt), 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters. ADR-017 phase 3 makes it the row lookup key: register/heartbeat first resolve the row by fingerprint, so a machine that changed IP reuses the existing row instead of creating a ghost row. Default/invalid -> the stored value is preserved (legacy executors or ones whose collection failed must never clear the stored fingerprint), and lookup falls back to by address.

installedPackages.description: R3-A（§4.3/P10）：设备已安装的执行器包清单。三态语义与 interpreters 同款：缺省 → 保留 DB 旧值；[] → 已上报且无安装包；结构非法/超 100 项 → 整字段拒绝采纳。
installedPackages.x-i18n-en: R3-A (§4.3/P10): executor packages installed on the device. Same three-state semantics as interpreters: omitted -> keep the stored DB value; [] -> reported with nothing installed; structurally invalid or more than 100 items -> the whole field is rejected.

interpreters.description: python_task_multiversion：解释器缓存池清单。缺省 → 保留已存值；[] → 已上报且池为空；结构非法 → 整字段被拒绝。
interpreters.x-i18n-en: python_task_multiversion: interpreter cache pool manifest. Default -> keep the stored value; [] -> reported with an empty pool; invalid structure -> the entire field is rejected.

maxConcurrentTasks.description: E9：更新后的最大并发任务数（热更新容量）
maxConcurrentTasks.x-i18n-en: E9: updated max concurrent tasks (hot-updated capacity)

registrationConflict.description: 方案 b（协议 v8，接管自愈死锁修复）：执行器的 /token 409 慢性冲突自报——自最近一次 409 起持续至成功取回 token。三态：缺席 = 未上报（旧执行器/python，中台按旧语义不动活性判定）；false = 已上报且当前无冲突（executor-node 恒发送，含 false）；true = 冲突中——中台消费判据：true 且心跳指纹与行已存真实指纹错位 → 活性四列（status/offlineReason/consecutiveHeartbeatMisses/lastHeartbeat）不登记，心跳不再把冲突行保持 ONLINE（sweep 判死 → 接管窗 → E-1 CAS 收敛）。仅文档用：本类不挂 class-validator（内联 body 元类型 = Object），实际采纳在 controller F-7 白名单与 service 侧判据。
registrationConflict.x-i18n-en: Protocol v8 (takeover self-heal, plan b): executor self-report of chronic /token 409 conflict — set from the most recent 409 until a token is successfully obtained. Tri-state: absent = not reported (legacy executors / python without support; the control plane keeps legacy liveness semantics); false = reported and currently conflict-free; true = conflict in progress

reservedSlots.description: E-01-RPT（协议 v4）：pull 长轮询已预留但尚未领取的槽位。runningTaskCount 统计的是已占用槽位（含本次预留，这正是 E-01 防超卖机制）；runningExecutionIds 只列出已领取的执行。因此详情页用 runningTaskCount - reservedSlots 展示实际运行数。仅供展示 —— 派发门禁从不读取该字段。总是发送（0 = 已上报且无预留）；缺失 = legacy 执行器。
reservedSlots.x-i18n-en: E-01-RPT (protocol v4): slots reserved by pull long polling but not yet claimed. runningTaskCount counts occupied slots (including this reservation, which is exactly the E-01 anti-oversell mechanism); runningExecutionIds lists only claimed executions. The detail page therefore shows the actual running count as runningTaskCount - reservedSlots. Display only — the dispatch gate never reads this field. Always sent (0 = reported with no reservation); missing = legacy executor.

runningExecutionIds.description: CONSISTENCY-02：当前运行中的执行 ID
runningExecutionIds.x-i18n-en: CONSISTENCY-02: ID of the currently running execution

startupId.description: 启动 ID（进程生命周期标识）

taskSandbox.description: S4-C4（协议 v9，沙箱姿态在控制面可见）：执行器的任务沙箱姿态（取自执行器本地环境变量 TASK_SANDBOX，执行器恒发送该键）。**三态纪律（本项核心）**：① 键**缺席** = 旧执行器**未上报**（升级期新旧并存是常态）→ 落库 NULL、详情页显示「未上报」，**绝不当成直跑**——「不知道」与「确认没开」是两件事；② `''` = 已上报且**直跑**（未沙箱）；③ `'bwrap'` = 已上报且**在 fail-closed 沙箱里**。取值域只有这两个，其它值 → service 侧 warn + 按未上报处理（fail-safe：宁可显示「不知道」，也不把非法值猜成直跑或沙箱）。落库语义：缺省 → 保留 DB 旧值（旧执行器绝不清空已上报的姿态）；合法（含 `''`）→ 覆盖。仅文档用：本类不挂 class-validator（内联 body 元类型 = Object），实际采纳在 controller F-2 白名单与 service 侧判据。
taskSandbox.x-i18n-en: S4-C4 (protocol v9, sandbox posture visible on the control plane): the executor's task sandbox posture (read from the executor's local TASK_SANDBOX environment variable; the executor always sends this key). **Three-state discipline (the core of this item)**: (1) key **absent** = old executor did **not report** (old and new executors coexist during rollout, which is normal) -> store NULL, the detail page shows "not reported", and it is **never treated as unsandboxed** - "unknown" and "confirmed off" are two different things; (2) `''` = reported and running **unsandboxed**; (3) `'bwrap'` = reported and running **inside a fail-closed sandbox**. The value domain is only those two; any other value -> service-side warn and treated as "not reported" (fail-safe: rather show "unknown" than guess an illegal value into unsandboxed or sandboxed). Persistence semantics: absent -> keep the existing DB value (an old executor must never clear a posture that was already reported); valid (including `''`) -> overwrite. Documentation only: this class carries no class-validator (the inline body metatype is Object); actual acceptance happens in the controller F-2 allowlist and the service-side criteria.

Every value must be an existing task id; self-dependencies and cycles are rejected on the write path.

deploymentPolicy.description: FEAT-22：任务级部署派发策略覆盖。'strict' 把候选收窄为显式部署了绑定应用的设备集合（running/stopped/upgrading）；当其中没有任何设备可承接该执行时，执行会以 WAITING 排队，而不是静默派发到别处。'prefer' 保留 ARCH-35 的软偏好（优先尝试已部署且运行中的设备，否则回落到全集群）。缺省/null = 跟随全局 executor.deploymentPolicy（EXECUTOR_DEPLOYMENT_POLICY）。优先级：executorId 钉定 > executorAppName > 部署约束 > 全集群；总开关 executor.preferDeployedExecutor=false 会彻底关闭部署感知。PATCH：缺省 = 保留；显式 null = 跟随全局。
deploymentPolicy.x-i18n-en: FEAT-22: task-level deployment dispatch policy override. 'strict' narrows the candidates to the set of devices that explicitly deployed the bound application (running/stopped/upgrading); when none of them can take the execution, it queues as WAITING instead of being silently dispatched elsewhere. 'prefer' keeps the ARCH-35 soft preference (try deployed and running devices first, otherwise falls back to the whole cluster). Default/null = follow the global executor.deploymentPolicy (EXECUTOR_DEPLOYMENT_POLICY). Precedence: executorId pinning > executorAppName > deployment constraint > whole cluster; the master switch executor.preferDeployedExecutor=false turns deployment awareness off entirely. PATCH: omitted = keep; explicit null = follow the global setting.

estimatedDurationSec.description: CORE-05：预估执行时长（秒；0 或缺省 = 未知）。仅用于调度侧的 executor 负载评分（预估越长，对繁忙执行器的惩罚越大）；执行链路（心跳/超时/统计）从不消费该字段。PATCH 时显式 null = 重置为未知。
estimatedDurationSec.x-i18n-en: CORE-05: estimated execution duration (seconds; 0 or default = unknown). Used only by the scheduling side for executor load scoring (a longer estimate penalizes busy executors more); the execution path (heartbeat/timeout/statistics) never consumes this field. On PATCH, an explicit null = reset to unknown.

executeMode.description: 派发模式：single（在符合条件的执行器中选择负载最低的一台，缺省）或 broadcast（扇出到所有符合条件的在线执行器）。与 executorId 钉定互斥；当绑定应用带有互斥组时以 400 拒绝（broadcast 无法遵守组内并发上限）。
executeMode.x-i18n-en: Dispatch mode: single (pick the least loaded of the eligible executors; default) or broadcast (fan out to all eligible online executors). Mutually exclusive with pinning via executorId; rejected with 400 when the bound application has a mutex group (broadcast cannot honor the in-group concurrency cap).

executorAffinityTags.description: NF-04：执行器标签亲和（OR 语义——持有其中**任一**标签的执行器即为候选；随后在命中集合内按 loadScore 择优）。broadcast 模式下扇出收窄为命中亲和标签的执行器子集。与 executorTags（硬性 AND 子集能力要求）正交。PATCH：缺省 = 保留；显式 null/[] = 清除。
executorAffinityTags.x-i18n-en: NF-04: executor tag affinity (OR semantics - an executor holding **any** of these tags is a candidate; the best is then chosen within the matching set by loadScore). In broadcast mode the fan-out narrows to the subset of executors matching the affinity tags. Orthogonal to executorTags (a hard AND subset capability requirement). PATCH: default = keep; explicit null/[] = clear.

executorAntiAffinityTags.description: NF-04：执行器标签反亲和（排除语义——持有其中**任一**标签的执行器即被排除）。单发与 broadcast 均生效；与亲和标签组合时，先取亲和命中集再在其上剔除。PATCH：缺省 = 保留；显式 null/[] = 清除。
executorAntiAffinityTags.x-i18n-en: NF-04: executor label anti-affinity (exclusion semantics - an executor holding **any** of these labels is excluded). Applies to both single dispatch and broadcast; when combined with affinity labels, the affinity hit set is taken first and then filtered. PATCH: default = keep; explicit null/[] = clear.

executorId.description: 把任务钉定到指定执行器：派发**只**发往该执行器（绕过分组/标签过滤）；它离线时快速失败。与 executeMode=broadcast 互斥。
executorId.x-i18n-en: Pin the task to a specific executor: dispatch goes **only** to that executor (bypassing group/label filtering); it fails fast when that executor is offline. Mutually exclusive with executeMode=broadcast.

expectedUpdatedAt.description: 乐观锁预期值：编辑前读取的任务 updatedAt（ISO 时间串）。传入即启用并发检查，不匹配返回 409；缺省跳过检查。
expectedUpdatedAt.x-i18n-en: Optimistic lock expected value: the task updatedAt read before editing (ISO time string). Supplying it enables the concurrency check and returns 409 on mismatch; the default skips the check.

maintenanceWindows.description: 任务级维护窗口：落在窗口内的定时触发会被跳过（手动/API 触发不受影响）。每项为 {start, end, description?}，start/end 均为 5 字段 cron；窗口在最近一次 start-cron 触达时开启、在最近一次 end-cron 触达时关闭。最多 10 条。
maintenanceWindows.x-i18n-en: Task-level maintenance windows: scheduled triggers falling inside a window are skipped (manual/API triggers are unaffected). Each entry is {start, end, description?}, where start/end are both 5-field cron; a window opens at the most recent start-cron hit and closes at the most recent end-cron hit. At most 10 entries.

name.description: 任务名称——允许任意语言（含中文/日文/emoji）。拒绝控制字符与首尾空白；长度上限 255 字符。全部任务（含软删除行）内全局唯一。
name.x-i18n-en: Task name - any language allowed (including Chinese/Japanese/emoji). Control characters and leading/trailing whitespace are rejected; maximum length 255 characters. Globally unique across all tasks (including soft-deleted rows).

params.description: 任务默认参数；序列化后体积不得超过 65536 字节（与 trigger/webhook 面同一上限）。
params.x-i18n-en: Default task parameters; the serialized size must not exceed 65536 bytes (the same limit as the trigger/webhook surface).

projectId.description: 所属项目。缺省/null = 未分配（计入默认项目视图；与既有行为一致）。设置它需要 ADMIN 或该项目的 editor/admin。
projectId.x-i18n-en: Owning project. Default/null = unassigned (counted in the default project view; consistent with existing behavior). Setting it requires ADMIN or editor/admin on that project.

requirements.description: 任务运行前由执行器安装的依赖声明——pip 依赖（python runtime，每任务独立 uv venv）或 npm 包（node runtime）。GLUE 脚本任务忽略该字段。示例：[\"requests>=2.31\", \"rich==13.7.1\"]
requirements.x-i18n-en: Dependency declaration installed by the executor before the task runs - pip dependencies (python runtime, a separate uv venv per task) or npm packages (node runtime). GLUE script tasks ignore this field. Example: [\"requests>=2.31\", \"rich==13.7.1\"]

runOnUpstreamFailure.description: 失败边：上游依赖进入失败终态（FAILED/TIMEOUT/KILLED/CANCELLED）时也触发本任务（默认 false）
runOnUpstreamFailure.x-i18n-en: Failure edge: also trigger this task when an upstream dependency reaches a failed terminal state (FAILED/TIMEOUT/KILLED/CANCELLED) (default false)

runbook.description: FEAT-11：markdown 运维手册——展示在任务详情页，并随失败通知/告警一并附上。
runbook.x-i18n-en: FEAT-11: markdown runbook - shown on the task detail page and attached to failure notifications/alerts.

runtimeVersion.description: 任务所需的 Python 解释器版本，格式为 \"major.minor\"（例如 \"3.7\"、\"3.12\"）。支持区间默认 3.7–3.14；3.7 仅支持离线预置（uv 无法在线下载）。仅在 runtime=python 时有意义。
runtimeVersion.x-i18n-en: Python interpreter version required by the task, in \"major.minor\" format (for example \"3.7\", \"3.12\"). The supported range defaults to 3.7-3.14; 3.7 is available only as an offline preset (uv cannot download it online). Only meaningful when runtime=python.

secrets.description: 任务级 secrets（凭据键值对，独立于 params 的普通运行参数；配置了 SEC_SECRETS_KEY 时以 AES-256-GCM 加密落库，未配置则降级明文并告警）。读路径一律以字面量 ****** 掩码。派发时走两条通道：合并进 params（AUTOFLOW_<KEY>，旧执行器通道）并作为独立载荷字段下发，使执行器按**原名**注入（第三方 SDK 要求规范名）。PATCH 时按**逐键合并**：键缺省或叶子值为 ****** 时保留已存值，叶子值为 null 时删除该键，其它值覆盖；整个字段显式 null 时清空全部 secret。
secrets.x-i18n-en: Task-level secrets (credential key-value pairs, independent of the ordinary run parameters in params; persisted encrypted with AES-256-GCM when SEC_SECRETS_KEY is configured, otherwise degraded to plaintext with a warning). Read paths always mask them with the literal ******. Dispatch uses two channels: merged into params (AUTOFLOW_<KEY>, the legacy executor channel) and sent as a separate payload field so the executor injects them under their **original names** (third-party SDKs require canonical names). On PATCH they are merged **key by key**: a missing key or a leaf value of ****** keeps the stored value, a leaf value of null deletes that key, any other value overwrites; an explicit null for the whole field clears all secrets.

timeout.description: 任务执行超时秒数（遗留字段；建议使用 timeoutSeconds）。0 = 不限制；上限为执行器的 1..86400 窗口（executor-node 每次尝试都会以 400 拒绝更大的值）。
timeout.x-i18n-en: Task execution timeout in seconds (legacy field; prefer timeoutSeconds). 0 = unlimited; capped by the executor's 1..86400 window (executor-node rejects larger values with 400 on every attempt).

timeoutAction.description: CORE-04：任务超时后的动作。kill（缺省）= 执行器按既有语义树杀进程；kill_retry = 同样树杀，但 admin 按任务的重试预算重新入队一次执行；notify_only = admin 只下发超时告警、不额外下发终止指令（执行器自身的硬超时仍然生效）。PATCH 时缺省 = 保留当前值；显式 null = 重置回 kill。
timeoutAction.x-i18n-en: CORE-04: action after a task times out. kill (default) = the executor kills the process tree using the existing semantics; kill_retry = the same tree kill, but admin re-enqueues one execution according to the task's retry budget; notify_only = admin only raises a timeout alert and sends no extra termination instruction (the executor's own hard timeout still applies). On PATCH, absent = keep the current value; explicit null = reset back to kill.

timeoutSeconds.description: 任务执行超时秒数。0 = 不限制；上限为执行器的 1..86400 窗口（会归一化到 `timeout`，executor-node 对超过 86400 的值以 400 拒绝）。
timeoutSeconds.x-i18n-en: Task execution timeout in seconds. 0 = no limit; capped at the executor's 1..86400 window (normalized to `timeout`; executor-node rejects values above 86400 with 400).

timeoutWarnRatio.description: CORE-04：超时预警阈值，取 timeout 的百分数（整数 0-90）。运行时长达到 timeout × ratio/100 时发送一次 WARNING 预警通知（每个执行至多一次）。缺省/null = 未启用。
timeoutWarnRatio.x-i18n-en: CORE-04: timeout warning threshold, a percentage of timeout (integer 0-90). When the run duration reaches timeout x ratio/100, one WARNING notice is sent (at most once per execution). Default/null = disabled.

timezone.x-i18n-en: IANA time zone used for cron scheduling, e.g. Asia/Shanghai

isActive.x-i18n-en: Enable/disable the account (ADMIN-only; disabling makes login return 403 and invalidates in-flight sessions immediately)

failed.x-i18n-en: Number of FAILED rows (always excluded; redeploy explicitly instead)

inFlight.description: pending/deploying/upgrading 在途行数（恒跳过，逐行进 skipped 明细）
inFlight.x-i18n-en: Number of in-flight rows (pending/deploying/upgrading; always skipped, each listed in the skipped detail)

running.description: RUNNING 且 runMode≠scheduled 的行数（活进程语义：daemon/once）
running.x-i18n-en: Number of RUNNING rows with runMode != scheduled (live-process semantics: daemon/once)

scheduled.description: RUNNING 且 runMode=scheduled 的行数（仅部署待触发——实证口径：scheduled 部署完成即上报 running，行稳态就是 RUNNING，默认与 running 一并覆盖）
scheduled.x-i18n-en: Number of RUNNING rows with runMode = scheduled (deploy-only, awaiting task trigger - empirically a scheduled deploy reports running on completion, so the row's steady state is RUNNING and it is covered together with running by default)

stopped.description: STOPPED 行数（仅 includeStopped=true 时纳入升级；计数恒回显）
stopped.x-i18n-en: Number of STOPPED rows (upgraded only when includeStopped=true; the count is always reported)

includeStopped.description: all 策略下把 stopped 部署行一并纳入升级（缺省 false——stopped 可能是人为停用）。pending/deploying/upgrading 在途行恒跳过并进响应 skipped 明细；failed 行恒排除（应走显式重新部署）。canary 策略忽略本参数
includeStopped.x-i18n-en: Include STOPPED deployment rows in the upgrade under the all strategy (default false - stopped may be a deliberate shutdown). pending/deploying/upgrading in-flight rows are always skipped and listed in the response skipped detail; failed rows are always excluded (redeploy explicitly instead). The canary strategy ignores this flag

version.description: 本次灰度定向到某个历史 released 版本（version **字符串**，非 uuid）——用于渐进式回滚。缺省：应用当前版本。注意：该参数等价于 set-current-version + deploy-version 的组合（先按快照恢复应用当前字段，再下发），且会改写中台当前版本——R1（§4.2）拆分出的这两个端点是更明确的表达，建议改用新端点
version.x-i18n-en: This rollout targets a historical released version (version **string**, not uuid) - used for progressive rollback. Default: the application's current version. Note: this parameter is equivalent to the set-current-version + deploy-version combination (it first restores the application fields from the snapshot, then dispatches) and rewrites the platform's current version - the two R1 (§4.2) split endpoints express this more explicitly; prefer them

coverage.description: 该应用部署行按状态分组的计数（R2 §4.4）。running+scheduled 为默认覆盖面；stopped 仅 includeStopped=true 时升级；failed 恒排除；inFlight 恒跳过

The batch is in-process state: an admin-api restart pauses it (row-level rolloutState=failed). R2 (deployment model review §4.4): coverage made explicit - default = all RUNNING deployment rows (including scheduled deploy-only rows: empirically a scheduled deploy reports running on completion, so their steady state is RUNNING); includeStopped=true additionally includes stopped rows under the all strategy (canary ignores the flag - health probing needs live processes); pending/deploying/upgrading in-flight rows are always skipped and listed in the response skipped detail (no error thrown); failed rows are always excluded. The response adds coverage with per-status counts. The version targeting parameter is equivalent to the set-current-version + deploy-version combination (it rewrites the platform's current version); prefer the R1 split endpoints

PLAN-BACKEND-ARCHITECTURE §2.1 (additive transition, same shape as GET /audit and GET /tasks/executions/all): adds an optional `cursor` parameter — when omitted the existing OFFSET pagination is used and the response is **byte-for-byte identical** to before (no nextCursor key); when supplied with the previous page nextCursor the keyset branch is used ((createdAt,id) tuple cursor, row-value comparison) and `nextCursor` is **appended** to the response (null = last page reached). The response shape stays the bare {items,total} (deliberately NOT switched to the paginate envelope — items is consumed by the admin-web package table and the install wizard). This endpoint always orders by createdAt DESC, id DESC, so the cursor can be freely combined with every filter (name/type/status/platform). An invalid cursor returns 400 (VALIDATION_FAILED) and never silently falls back to the first page. To enter keyset mode for the first time, pass an empty value `?cursor=`.

x-i18n-en.description: A6 (DEEP_REVIEW): a read-only reconciliation view over an executor's local callback dead letter directory. Returns execution records on that executor that have reached a terminal state (success/failed/timeout/killed/cancelled), ordered by terminal time ascending, so callers can consume it as a watermark stream. Executors use it to triage dead letters: a dead-letter callback for an execution already in a terminal state is meaningless (delete it outright); one whose execution has not finished and whose dead-letter cause is an exhausted retry budget is worth re-enqueuing; poison payloads (oversized/corrupt) are retained for manual investigation. Strictly read-only - it changes no state, releases no slots, and writes no audit records; all state changes still go through the existing callback/terminal paths.

get.description: 获取任务列表，支持分页与搜索。可按状态过滤。PLAN-BACKEND-ARCHITECTURE §2.1（加性过渡，与 GET /tasks/:id/executions 同款）：新增可选 `cursor` 参数——省略时走既有 OFFSET 分页，响应与之前**逐字节一致**（不含 nextCursor 键）；传入上一页响应的 `data.nextCursor` 时走 keyset 分页（(createdAt,id) 元组游标，深翻页不再随 OFFSET 变慢），并在响应中**追加** `nextCursor`（null = 已到末页）。游标绑定默认排序 createdAt DESC, id DESC，故与 `sortBy` 或 `lastStatus` 同时给出会返回 400（不静默错乱）；非法游标同样 400（VALIDATION_FAILED），不会静默退回第一页。首次进入 keyset 模式请传空值 `?cursor=`。

parameters.description: 仅按任务名称模糊搜索（向后兼容通道；CLI/MCP 使用它）。控制台搜索框改用 `q`，因为其占位符承诺搜索名称或描述。
parameters.name: name
parameters.x-i18n-en: Fuzzy search by task name only (backward-compatible channel; used by CLI/MCP). The console search box uses `q` instead, because its placeholder promises searching names or descriptions.

parameters.description: 同时按任务名称与描述做关键字搜索。LIKE 元字符（% 与 _）按字面匹配，因此搜索 `daily_report` 不会同时命中 `dailyXreport`。可与其他所有列表过滤条件组合。
parameters.name: q
parameters.x-i18n-en: Keyword search across both task name and description. LIKE metacharacters (% and _) match literally, so searching `daily_report` does not also match `dailyXreport`. Combines with all other list filters.

parameters.description: 不透明的 keyset 游标（上一页响应的 data.nextCursor）。省略时走原有 OFFSET 分页，响应与之前完全一致；传入时走 keyset 分支并追加 nextCursor。首次进入 keyset 模式传空值（?cursor=）。仅与默认排序组合——与 sortBy 或 lastStatus 同时给出返回 400。非法游标返回 400（VALIDATION_FAILED），不会静默退回第一页。
parameters.name: cursor
parameters.x-i18n-en: Opaque keyset cursor (the data.nextCursor from the previous page). When omitted, the existing OFFSET pagination is used and the response is exactly as before; when supplied, the keyset branch is used and nextCursor is appended to the response. To enter keyset mode for the first time, pass an empty value (?cursor=). Only combinable with the default ordering — supplying it together with sortBy or lastStatus returns 400. An invalid cursor returns 400 (VALIDATION_FAILED) and never silently falls back to the first page.

parameters.description: F-10：逗号分隔的投影白名单（例如 'id,name'）。只查询白名单内的轻量列——跳过 params/secrets/glueSource 等重型列。非法字段 → 400。
parameters.name: fields
parameters.x-i18n-en: F-10: comma-separated projection allowlist (for example 'id,name'). Only lightweight columns in the allowlist are queried -- heavy columns such as params/secrets/glueSource are skipped. Invalid field -> 400.

parameters.description: P2-18：过滤「最近一次执行」处于该状态的任务（每个任务取最新一行 task_executions：createdAt DESC、id DESC）。取值：pending/running/waiting/success/failed/timeout/killed/cancelled。最近一次执行仍在进行中（pending/running）时按原样匹配。以 EXISTS 子查询实现——可与其他列表过滤条件组合。
parameters.name: lastStatus
parameters.x-i18n-en: P2-18: filter tasks whose most recent execution is in this state (the latest task_executions row per task: createdAt DESC, id DESC). Values: pending/running/waiting/success/failed/timeout/killed/cancelled. When the most recent execution is still in progress (pending/running), it matches as-is. Implemented as an EXISTS subquery - composable with other list filters.

200.description: 分页列表（list/items 双键，R-21）。默认投影 = 完整实体但密钥已掩码；?fields= 会裁剪 items（F-10）。带 cursor 时额外含 nextCursor。

get.summary: 列出任务

x-i18n-en.description: List tasks with pagination and search. Can be filtered by status. PLAN-BACKEND-ARCHITECTURE §2.1 (additive transition, same as GET /tasks/:id/executions): a new optional `cursor` parameter — when omitted, the existing OFFSET pagination is used and the response is byte-for-byte identical to before (no nextCursor key); when the previous page's `data.nextCursor` is passed, keyset pagination is used ((createdAt,id) tuple cursor, so deep paging no longer slows down with OFFSET) and `nextCursor` is appended to the response (null = last page). The cursor is bound to the default ordering createdAt DESC, id DESC, so supplying it together with `sortBy` or `lastStatus` returns 400 (never silently inconsistent); an invalid cursor also returns 400 (VALIDATION_FAILED) and never silently falls back to the first page. To enter keyset mode for the first time, pass an empty value `?cursor=`.

x-i18n-en.description: Public machine-call endpoint. Requires X-AutoCodeFlow-Timestamp and X-Hub-Signature-256 headers; the signature is HMAC-SHA256 over `${timestamp}.${rawBody}` using the task's webhook secret (enable via POST /api/tasks/:id/webhook/enable). The `{ params }` body overrides the task's default params for this execution. Add `?wait=1&timeout=N` to hold the request until the execution reaches a terminal state (N ≤ 300 seconds; on timeout it returns `completed:false` with the latest snapshot). Unknown task / webhook disabled / bad signature all return the same 401. A duplicate delivery within the ±5 minute window returns `{deduplicated:true}` (no re-trigger; use `X-AutoFlow-Delivery` to supply a delivery idempotency key, otherwise the signature is used).
x-i18n-en.summary: Trigger a task via inbound Webhook
